arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && grep -n "if __name__" fuzz_value.py | head -3; python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('/workspace/tmp/fuzz_value.py').read()
# wrap the trailing driver in a main guard
idx = s.index("rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1])")
head, tail = s[:idx], s[idx:]
lines = tail.split('\n')
out = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('if __name__'):
        out.append(line); continue
    out.append(('    ' + line) if line.strip() else line)
body = '\n'.join(out)
open('/workspace/tmp/fuzz_value.py','w').write(head + body + "\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n")
EOF
python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fuzz_value; print('import clean')" 2>&1 | tail -2
